data.one_liner: WebSockets support and event broadcasting for the Angel3 framework.
data.what_it_does: Provides WebSocket server integration and client libraries for Angel3. It automatically broadcasts events from hooked services, adds WebSocket support to controllers, and allows reconnection handling on both browser and CLI clients.
use_when: You are building an Angel3 backend and need real-time WebSocket communication.
You want automatic broadcasting of service events to connected clients.
You need CLI or browser WebSocket clients compatible with Angel3 services.
avoid_when: You are using a backend framework other than Angel3.
You only need raw WebSockets without framework bindings or hooked services.
strengths: Includes both browser and CLI client implementations with auto-reconnect
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Angel3 framework ecosystem
Does not support WebSockets over HTTP/2 (refuses with 501)
data.setup_notes: Configure the server plugin with app.configure(ws.configureServer) and map routes with ws.handleRequest.

alternatives.name: shelf_web_socket
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using Shelf instead of Angel3 for your Dart backend.

alternatives.name: web_socket_channel
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a generic, framework-agnostic WebSocket wrapper for Dart.
